title: Are You Sleeping? on a Snowy Morning with Lulu | Nursery Rhyme
description:
Sing along to Are You Sleeping? with Lulu the little duck on a snowy winter morning! The golden bells go ding, dang, dong, and Lulu gently wakes up Penguin, the squirrel and the friendly snowman as soft snow begins to fall.
The words light up with the music, for children aged 2 to 6.
A classic nursery rhyme (traditional, 18th century; English words 19th century).
